system.description:
Effect: As an extra action on your turn, you can move a short or long distance If you use this extra action to move a short distance, this doesn’t hinder your tasks. If you use this extra action to move a long distance, your tasks until your next turn are only hindered by one step instead of two.

Explanation: It was a little bit downhill the whole way. You were the fastest kid in school. Fear is a strong motivator.
